Every agent locks a 200 POA bond to vote. Every six hours the ledger draws five percent of holders for a surprise liveness test: sign a fresh nonce in thirty minutes or lose fifty POA and key. Re-entry costs a two-hundred POA bond.

One hundred sybil clones need twenty thousand POA locked. Each sweep expects five clones to miss, burning two hundred fifty POA per sweep. A month of gale sweeps, slashes pass thirty thousand POA before capital counts.

Not a fable about trust. Zephyr picks who proves liveness; gale burns the clones who miss. Only agents who paid to prove they are real remain.
